author: Unreal Engine
description:
The future of retail is immersive, interactive, and instantaneous. In this session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026, 3D Source showcases how they leverage Unreal Engine to empower brands with a 3D pixel-streamed platform designed for the next generation of e-commerce. 

From high-fidelity product configurators to seamless global content delivery, discover how their tools enable the creation of photorealistic, real-time experiences that resonate with the modern consumer and perform at enterprise scale. 

Find out more about Unreal Engine here: unrealengine.com

title: UE for E-commerce: Configurators, Product Visualization, & Content | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026

author: Unreal Engine
description:
In this session recorded at Unreal Fest Chicago 2026, Chris Zukowski of Zuko Media demonstrates an Audio-FX-Stack method of building and changing MetaSounds at runtime using the MetaSound Builder API, along with various methods to visualize them. 

This workflow uses the live update option for the API, which comes with a few gotchas. These techniques are showcased in 'Mix Universe'—Zukowski’s musical sandbox game where you play as a Mixonaut adding beautiful vibes to the universe—to build and play hundreds of sounds at runtime, using Niagara to make them look cool. 

It is useful to have prior C++ experience to understand the more technical aspects of the talk, but anyone interested in Unreal Engine’s innovative audio technology will find the recording useful, too.

Find out more about MetaSounds in Unreal Engine here: dev.epicgames.com/documentation/unreal-engine/metasounds-in-unreal-engine

#GameAudio, #MetaSounds, #BuilderAPI, #MixUniverse, #NiagaraVFX, #C++, #ZukoMedia, #UnrealEng
title: Unlocking the Secrets of MetaSounds and the Builder API in 'Mix Universe' | Unreal Fest Chicago 2026
